title: DAILYDILEMMAS: REVEALING VALUE PREFERENCES OF LLMS WITH QUANDARIES OF DAILY LIFE
reasoning: The paper introduces DAILYDILEMMAS, a dataset and benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the moral and ethical reasoning of LLMs. It presents models with everyday dilemmas and analyzes their decisions through the lens of five theoretical frameworks, including Moral Foundations Theory and Aristotle's Virtues, to uncover their underlying value prioritizations.
